sample_unit: patients (across general outpatient, psychiatric ED, and psychiatric inpatient cohorts)
models_evaluated: Regularized Cox regression landmark models predicting suicide attempt at 18 months

links.outcome: Suicide attempt model AUC, sensitivity, PPV by race/ethnicity and gender across three clinical settings
links.effect: Stronger performance for male vs. female patients consistently; race/ethnicity results equivocal (higher AUC for White than Hispanic in outpatient, highest for Asian in psychiatric ED); intersectional gaps favoring White men.
links.quote: When considering gender alone, models showed consistently stronger performance for male vs. female patients.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating algorithmic bias and fairness (equity) across race/ethnicity and gender for previously validated suicide risk prediction models using retrospective EHR data.
